# shoal_role (Resource)

A custom role: a named set of permissions (`resource:verb`, wildcards allowed, e.g. `runs:*`). Built-in roles (`tenant-admin`, `namespace-admin`, `editor`, `operator`, `viewer`) cannot be changed. See the `shoal_permissions` data source for the full list. Maps to `/v1/roles/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shoal_role" "runner" {
  name        = "runner"
  description = "Run and approve workflows, read everything"
  permissions = ["*:read", "runs:create", "runs:approve", "runs:cancel"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission patterns, e.g. `["workflows:read", "runs:*"]`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the role is for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_role.runner runner
```
